main_text.p: aut plures res significat, hoc modo: Paterfamilias cum fi-« lium heredem faceret, testa-« mento uasa argētea uxori le-« gauit: Tullius heres meus Te-« rentiæ uxori meæ XXX pó« do uasorum argenteorum da-« to, quę uolet. post mortem e-« ius preciosa uasa & caelata ma-« gnifice illa petit. Tullius se,« quae uelit ipse, XXX pondo« ei debere dicit. Cōstitutio est« ex ambiguo. Eiusmodi con-« trouersia illa est, An res em-« pta, & tradita, emptoris ta-men non fit, antequam pre-ciū persoluerit: de qua iurisconsulti in L. quod uendidi, 19.D.de contrah.empt. & L.

page.notes: Word "pó" at the end of line 5 is read as the start of "pondo", abbreviated with a mark over the o; it is continued by "do" on the next line without a hyphen, so the split is kept as printed [?]. "quę" has a cedilla under the e as printed. Handwritten annotation "aliud" beside line 13 is excluded. Printed "con-" and "pre-" hyphens are kept as printed. Page ends mid-sentence with catchword "pro-".
